questions.answer: $f'(x) = \frac{\sec x\tan x + \sec^2 x}{\sec x + \tan x} = \frac{\sec x(\tan x + \sec x)}{\sec x + \tan x} = \sec x$.

questions.q: Find $\dfrac{dy}{dx}$ for the curve $x^2 + xy + y^2 = 7$.
questions.answer: $2x + (y + x dy/dx) + 2y dy/dx = 0 \Rightarrow dy/dx(x + 2y) = -(2x + y) \Rightarrow dy/dx = -\frac{2x + y}{x + 2y}$.

questions.q: Find the gradient of the curve $x^3 + y^3 = 9xy$ at the point $(2, 4)$.
questions.answer: $3x^2 + 3y^2 y' = 9(y + x y') \Rightarrow x^2 + y^2 y' = 3y + 3x y'$. At $(2, 4)$: $4 + 16 y' = 12 + 6 y' \Rightarrow 10 y' = 8 \Rightarrow y' = 8/10 = 4/5$.

questions.q: Find the equation of the normal to the curve $x^2 - 2xy + 3y^2 = 9$ at $(3, 2)$.
questions.answer: Differentiate: $2x - 2(y + x y') + 6y y' = 0$. At $(3, 2)$: $6 - 2(2 + 3 y') + 12 y' = 0 \Rightarrow 6 - 4 - 6 y' + 12 y' = 0 \Rightarrow 2 + 6 y' = 0 \Rightarrow y' = -1/3$. Normal slope is 3. Equation: $y - 2 = 3(x - 3) \Rightarrow y = 3x - 7$.

questions.q: A curve is defined parametrically by $x = 2t^2, y = 4t$. Find $\dfrac{dy}{dx}$ in terms of $t$.
A curve has parametric equations $x = a\cos\theta, y = b\sin\theta$. Find the equation of the tangent at parameter $\theta$.
questions.answer: $dx/d\theta = -a\sin\theta, dy/d\theta = b\cos\theta \Rightarrow dy/dx = -\frac{b\cos\theta}{a\sin\theta}$. Tangent: $y - b\sin\theta = -\frac{b\cos\theta}{a\sin\theta}(x - a\cos\theta) \Rightarrow \frac{y\sin\theta}{b} - \sin^2\theta = -\frac{x\cos\theta}{a} + \cos^2\theta \Rightarrow \frac{x}{a}\cos\theta + \frac{y}{b}\sin\theta = 1$.
